title: Dense-open Chow modification of a separated algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use algebraic spaces over $S$ and their small etale structure sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Modules, tensor pullback and direct image are on these ringed sites [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module, def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], with a specified map $\operatorname{Spec}A\to S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be separated of finite type [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties]. There exist a Noetherian scheme $V$, a representable proper surjective $A$-morphism $q:V\to X$, a dense open subspace $U\subseteq X$, and an immersion $e:V\to\mathbf P^r_A$ over $A$ for an integer $r\geq0$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], such that $q^{-1}(U)\to U$ is an isomorphism. Here immersion means an open immersion followed by a closed immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion]. No reducedness, irreducibility or flatness hypothesis is imposed. Noetherian means quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally Noetherian on etale scheme charts [pqf-def-locnoeth].

source.place: Tag 088U (lemma-chow-noetherian-separated), specialized to the affine Noetherian target; its application in Tag 08BE identifies the source with a scheme, the map as representable proper surjective, and the immersion as H-quasi-projective.

proof.text: Put $B=\operatorname{Spec}A$. Its single affine chart makes it locally Noetherian by [pqf-def-locnoeth], and [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs] gives quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness. Thus $B$ is a Noetherian scheme. Apply [lem-sfb-space-dense-affine-immersion] to $f:X\to B$, obtaining a dense quasi-compact open $U$ and $a:U\to\mathbf A^n_B$. By [lemma-nagata-relative-affine-space-open-immersion], the standard chart $\mathbf A^n_B$ is open in $\mathbf P^n_B$. A closed-then-open factorization of $a$ stays such a factorization after this open inclusion: the intermediate open in $\mathbf A^n_B$ is also open in $\mathbf P^n_B$. Write the resulting $B$-immersion as $a_P$.

source.place: Tag 088S (lemma-chow-noetherian), first sentence and standard affine chart; input 088N

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-blowup-embedding-extension] to the quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme $B$, the separated finite-type map $f$, the quasi-compact open $U$, and $a_P$. It supplies $Z\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^n_B$, a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal $\mathcal J$ on $Z$, its ordinary scheme blowup $Z'\to Z$, a scheme $V$ open in $Z'$, and a representable proper $B$-map $q:V\to X$. It also supplies the isomorphism $q^{-1}(U)\to U$. We retain this particular $U$; its density was already established in step 1.

The closed immersion $Z\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^n_B$ makes $Z\to B$ H-projective. Apply [lem-sfb-projective-affine-base-blowup] to $Z$, $A$, and $\mathcal J$. It gives an integer $r\geq0$ and a closed $B$-immersion $h:Z'\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^r_B$. Define $e=h\circ v$, where $v:V\hookrightarrow Z'$ is the open immersion from step 2. This is precisely an open immersion followed by a closed immersion over $B$, as required.

source.place: Tags 088S and 088U, projectivity enhancement over the affine scheme base; divisors.tex 02NS and morphisms.tex 087S, 01WE as packaged by the cited node

proof.text: Properness means universal closedness, separatedness, and finite type by [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties]. In particular $q(|V|)$ is closed in $|X|$. The isomorphism over $U$ shows $|U|\subseteq q(|V|)$. Since $U$ is dense, the only closed subset containing it is $|X|$. Hence $q$ is surjective. This also covers $X=\varnothing$, where the empty subset is dense in the empty space.

source.place: Tag 088U (lemma-chow-noetherian-separated), surjectivity of the dense-open modification from properness

proof.text: The maps $q$ and $f$ are of finite type, so [lem-sfb-space-finite-type-composition] gives finite type of $f q:V\to B$. Both source and target are now schemes, and the morphism-property convention [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties] agrees with the scheme convention. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] with the Noetherian scheme $B$ from step 1: $V$ is quasi-compact and locally Noetherian. By [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated], it is also quasi-separated, giving the Noetherian convention in the item. The data $V,q,U,e,r$ have all the asserted properties; reducedness, irreducibility and flatness have not been used.

The citations of locnoeth, affine qcqs, the open chart A^n in P^n, the new nodes, projective-affine-base-blowup, universal closedness and finite-type composition each say what the step takes from them; step 4 is genuinely elementary. dense-affine-immersion is a true specialization of 088N: finite presentation by 06G4, U is quasi-compact because X is Noetherian, and it is a scheme. blowup-embedding-extension is a true restatement of 088R with B a scheme.
